title: Elephant
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='24' fill='#8fa8c8'/>
  <!-- body lighter shade belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='22' ry='14' fill='#b0c4de'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='28' y='76' width='12' height='16' rx='5' fill='#7a94b5'/>
  <rect x='44' y='78' width='12' height='14' rx='5' fill='#8fa8c8'/>
  <rect x='58' y='78' width='12' height='14' rx='5' fill='#7a94b5'/>
  <rect x='72' y='76' width='12' height='16' rx='5' fill='#8fa8c8'/>
  <!-- leg toenails -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='90' r='2' fill='#dfeaf5'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='90' r='2' fill='#dfeaf5'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='90' r='2' fill='#dfeaf5'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='90' r='2' fill='#dfeaf5'/>
  <circle cx='81' cy='90' r='2' fill='#dfeaf5'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='24' fill='#9fb8d8'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='38' rx='14' ry='20' fill='#7a94b5'/>
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='38' rx='9' ry='14' fill='#c8a8d8'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='38' rx='14' ry='20' fill='#7a94b5'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='38' rx='9' ry='14' fill='#c8a8d8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='36' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#1a1a3a'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='36' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#1a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='34' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='34' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- trunk -->
  <path d='M50 48 Q48 60 44 70 Q42 76 46 78 Q50 80 52 74 Q56 62 54 48' fill='#9fb8d8' stroke='#b0c4de' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- trunk highlight -->
  <path d='M50 52 Q49 62 47 70 Q46 74 48 75' fill='none' stroke='#c8daf0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='46' r='4' fill='#e8a0b8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='46' r='4' fill='#e8a0b8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- smile/mouth hint -->
  <path d='M45 50 Q50 54 55 50' fill='none' stroke='#7a94b5' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tusk -->
  <path d='M46 54 Q44 60 46 63' fill='none' stroke='#f0e8d0' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M80 55 Q88 50 86 44' fill='none' stroke='#7a94b5' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='43' r='3' fill='#c8a8d8'/>
</svg>
